g.text: Variable projection did not beat the gradient fit, pooled or per-site

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange dot: scored year (2025-07 to 2026-06), difference in mean quantile score (points of capacity; lower is better) over the five decision sites; orange line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole calendar months (Bonferroni for four planned contrasts). Blue ring: the replicate year (2024-07 to 2025-06). C2v and C3v are over six substations; their comparators, the per-site VP models on 4 weeks and 3 months, extrapolate wildly (scores 49 to 71). The known-answer gate failed, so the verdict is capped at inconclusive.'
text.tspan: Orange dot: scored year (2025-07 to 2026-06), difference in mean quantile score (points of
capacity; lower is better) over the five decision sites; orange line: 98.75% interval from
resampling whole calendar months (Bonferroni for four planned contrasts). Blue ring: the
replicate year (2024-07 to 2025-06). C2v and C3v are over six substations; their comparators,
the per-site VP models on 4 weeks and 3 months, extrapolate wildly (scores 49 to 71). The
known-answer gate failed, so the verdict is capped at inconclusive.
